g.text: Why unused input rows stay unchanged HERE: fresh plain SGD; no momentum, weight decay, padding row, or shared output weights.

g.text: With optimizer history, weight decay, or tied input/output weights, an input-unused row can still change. Default gradients are dense; sparse mode differs.
